description: Get the daily horoscope for a zodiac sign. Returns the prediction text for a given day (today, tomorrow, yesterday, or a specific YYYY-MM-DD date). Useful for "what is my horoscope today" style questions.

day.description: Day to fetch. One of TODAY, TOMORROW, YESTERDAY, or a date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to TODAY.

sign.description: Zodiac sign (case-insensitive). One of: aries, taurus, gemini, cancer, leo, virgo, libra, scorpio, sagittarius, capricorn, aquarius, pisces.

name: daily_horoscope
title: Daily Horoscope
